description:
What is This Part?
This is the Suzuki OEM Cylinder Head Plug Kit
Provides all Necessary Plugs for the 1.3L / 8 Valve Engine
INCLUDES Guide Pins!
Made by SUZUKI
Direct Replacement
What Will I Receive?
Qty 2 – Guide Pins (Head to Block)
Qty 5 – Insert Plugs
Qty 1 – Screw-in Plug
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1995 All Models
Suzuki SJ413 1985 – 1995 All Models
